title: Ze and Hao
description: 加入了一些稀奇古怪又实用的物品！灵感来源于我的同学们 由一名高中生独立制作！  Added some quirky yet useful items! Inspired by my classmates and made entirely by a high school student!
body:
## **物品**
- _Ze's Brain (泽神的鬼脑)_
定位：远程武器。虽然它是一件物品，但右键使用会直接射出一支箭矢，无需蓄力。

机制：射出箭矢有 0.3 秒的冷却时间，并消耗自身耐久。

附魔：适用于弓类附魔（如力量、火矢、冲击等）

-  _佳豪的泡翅 (Jiahao's Bubble Wings)_
定位：高伤害近战武器，拥有 15点基础攻击伤害（可被锋利等附魔进一步提升）。

机制：作为一把剑，它拥有 1568 点耐久度，攻击速度与钻石剑一致。

特殊能力：右键使用会触发 “突进”效果，玩家会向前快速冲刺一段距离，并获得炫酷的粒子特效（包含火焰、龙息、附魔、电火花等多种粒子），冷却时间为 1 秒。

附魔：适用于所有剑类附魔。

- _佳豪的糖 (Jiahao's Candy)_
定位：战斗辅助食品。在任何时候都可以食用。

效果：食用后，提供 4点饥饿值恢复，并给予玩家强大的增益效果：

生命恢复 II，持续 5 秒

力量 III，持续 30 秒

迅捷 I，持续 30 秒

额外效果：食用后会立即清除玩家身上的所有负面状态效果（如中毒、虚弱等）。

合成配方：无序合成，材料为 1 个鸡蛋 + 1 桶牛奶 + 1 个小麦。
-  _附魔：万箭齐发 (Volley)_
定位：一个弓类专用的宝藏级附魔。

效果：当使用附有该魔咒的弓或 “Ze's Brain” 射出的箭矢命中生物时，会以目标为中心，在数秒内持续召唤一场小型的“箭雨”，对范围内的敌人造成额外打击，视觉效果华丽。

- 获取方式：可通过附魔台、村民交易、钓鱼或战利品箱获得。
  
- **兼容性
游戏版本：Minecraft 1.20.x

模组加载器：Fabric

前置模组：需要 Fabric API**



## **Items**
- _Ze's Brain (Zeshen's Ghost Brain)_
Role: Long-range weapon. Although it is an item, right-clicking fires an arrow directly without charging.

Mechanic: Shooting arrows has a 0.3-second cooldown and consumes own durability.

Enchantments: Suitable for bow-type enchantments (such as strength, fire arrows, impact, etc.)

- _Jiahao's Bubble Wings_
Role: High-damage melee weapon with 15 base attack damage (can be further enhanced by enchantments like Sharp).

Mechanics: As a sword, it has 1568 durability, with attack speed matching that of a diamond sword.

Special Ability: Using the right-click triggers the "Dash" effect, allowing players to dash forward quickly and gain cool particle effects (including flame, dragon breath, enchantment, electric spark, and other particles). Cooldown is 1 second.

Enchantments: Applicable to all sword enchantments.

- _Jiahao's Candy_
Position: Combat support food. It can be eaten at any time.

Effect: After consumption, it restores 4 hunger points and grants the player a powerful buff:

Life Recovery II, lasts 5 seconds

Power III, lasts 30 seconds

Swift I, lasts 30 seconds

Additional effect: After consumption, all negative status effects (such as poison, weakness, etc.) are immediately removed from the player.

Synthesis Recipe: Random synthesis, ingredients are 1 egg, 1 barrel of milk, 1 wheat.
- _Enchant: Volley (Volley)_
Role: A treasure-grade enchantment exclusive to bow types.

Effect: When arrows fired from a bow or "Ze's Brain" infused with this enchantment hit a creature, a small "arrow rain" is summoned for several seconds centered on the target, dealing additional damage to enemies within range for a spectacular visual effect.

- How to obtain: Available through enchantment tables, villager trades, fishing, or loot boxes.

- **Compatibility
Game version: Minecraft 1.20.x

Module loader: Fabric

Pre-mods: Requires Fabric API**
